title: Dutiable Commodities Ordinance
verified_how: Browser pane: https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap109. Title 'Cap. 109 Dutiable Commodities Ordinance'. Short title matches. Current version dated 17/07/2026.
notes: Hong Kong is a free port. Duty applies only to liquor, tobacco, hydrocarbon oil and methyl alcohol. Rates are in Schedule 1 of the Ordinance and in the Dutiable Commodities Regulations.
